title: Incremental Evaluation and Training in Relational Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.13023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) models multi-tabular databases as temporal heterogeneous graphs to enable end-to-end representation learning. However, prevailing RDL evaluation practices rely on static, single-episode dataset snapshots, overlooking the continuous, time-evolving nature of real-world databases. Consequently, current RDL benchmarks fail to capture how model performance changes as new data accumulates over time. To address this limitation, we introduce an incremental, multi-episode evaluation and training paradigm to assess and improve the temporal robustness and adaptability of state-of-the-art RDL models. Using established large-scale datasets, we examine data evolution and model training dynamics, demonstrating that temporal concept drifts occur in the majority of predictive tasks. translated_title: 关系深度学习中的增量评估与训练
translated_abstract: 关系深度学习（RDL）将多表格数据库建模为时间异构图，以实现端到端的表示学习。然而，现有的RDL评估实践依赖于静态的、单次数据集快照，忽视了现实世界数据库的连续、随时间演变的特性。因此，当前的RDL基准测试未能捕捉到随着新数据随时间积累，模型性能如何变化。为解决这一局限性，我们引入了一种增量式、多阶段的评估和训练范式，以评估并提升最先进的RDL模型的时间鲁棒性和适应性。利用已建立的大规模数据集，我们考察了数据演变和模型训练动态，证明在大多数预测任务中会发生时间概念漂移。我们提出了多种增量训练方案用于微调模型，并展示了迁移学习既可行又高效。
tldr: 本文提出了一种增量多阶段评估与训练范式，以应对关系深度学习中的时间概念漂移，证明迁移学习在提高模型时间鲁棒性方面高效可行。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an incremental multi-episode evaluation and training paradigm to address temporal concept drift in relational deep learning, demonstrating that transfer learning is efficient and feasible for improving model temporal robustness.
